dict.string: Liviqa adds a consultation you plan to your own calendar, with a reminder. It never reads your existing events.
Liviqa uses your camera only during a video consultation you start with your own clinician or coach, over an EU‑sovereign connection. It is never used otherwise.

Liviqa uses your microphone only when you start it yourself: recording a voice note for your private journal (kept on this device), or joining a video consultation with your own clinician or coach over an EU‑sovereign connection. It is never used otherwise.
Liviqa transcribes your voice notes on this device only. Your audio and words never leave your iPhone.
Liviqa can lock itself to your face, so only you can open your health edition. Face ID runs entirely on this device.
Liviqa reads your Health data on-device to show your trends and personal, plain-language nudges. Your health data stays on this device and is never uploaded.
Liviqa is read-only and never writes to Apple Health. It only reads your data on-device to show your trends and personal nudges; nothing is written back.
